description: Represents a single message in a chat conversation. A pure data record — TmChat renders it and never mutates it. Besides the rendering fields it carries a host-owned custom-template contract: Kind (a free-form routing string the host's MessageTemplate switches on), Metadata (a read-only dictionary, default empty, read via ChatMessageContext.GetMetadata<T>) and Payload (the original host DTO, read back via ChatMessageContext.PayloadAs<T>). TmChat does not interpret any of the three and never serializes them (Payload is JsonIgnore'd).

members.name: Id
members.description: Unique identifier; also the data-message-id scroll/focus anchor TmChat renders on the message wrapper.

members.name: Text
members.description: Message text content.

members.name: Author
members.description: Author of the message.

members.name: Timestamp
members.description: Timestamp when the message was sent.

members.name: Type
members.description: Message direction / type (Incoming, Outgoing, System).

members.name: Attachments
members.description: Optional attachments.

members.name: IsRead
members.description: Whether the message has been read by the recipient.

members.name: IsSending
members.description: Whether the message is currently being sent.

members.name: IsError
members.description: Whether the message failed to send.

members.name: ErrorMessage
members.description: Optional error text when sending failed.

members.name: ReplyToId
members.description: Id of the specific message this one replies to, when it is a reply.

members.name: ThreadRootId
members.description: Id of the root message of the thread this message belongs to (the root's own Id for a thread starter, the root id for its replies). Null for standalone messages.

members.name: ReplyCount
members.description: Number of replies in this message's thread (meaningful on a thread root).

members.name: Reactions
members.description: Emoji reactions on this message, grouped by emoji.

members.name: ReadBy
members.description: Per-user read receipts for this message.

members.name: EditedAt
members.description: Timestamp of the last edit, or null when the message was never edited.

members.name: IsDeleted
members.description: Whether the message has been deleted (rendered as a tombstone).

members.name: Kind
members.description: Free-form kind of the message, e.g. "ai-draft", "queued", "tip". TmChat itself does NOT interpret the value — it only carries it into the message template (ChatMessageContext.Message) and mirrors it on the message wrapper's data-kind attribute. Hosts use it to route a RenderFragment<ChatMessageContext> MessageTemplate (typically paired with UseTemplateFor) or their own grouping logic. Null for plain messages.

members.name: Metadata
members.description: Host-defined metadata entries. TmChat does NOT interpret them — they are handed to the message template untouched (read via ChatMessageContext.GetMetadata<T>(key, fallback)). Defaults to an empty read-only dictionary, never null. Values must be in-process CLR objects; after a host-side JSON round-trip they become JsonElement instances instead of the original CLR types.

members.name: Payload
members.description: The host's original DTO this message was mapped from. TmChat does NOT interpret it — the message template reads it back type-safely via ChatMessageContext.PayloadAs<T>(). Never serialized into any component event or log output (JsonIgnore).

members.name: IsEdited
members.description: True when the message carries an edit timestamp.

members.name: IsReply
members.description: True when the message is a reply within a thread.

members.name: IsReadByUser
members.description: Returns true when userId has read this message (its own IsRead flag or the ReadBy receipts).
